Question: Do you publish contact details for reporting security vulnerabilities and commit to acknowledging reports within a set time?
On request, do you let customers or their delegates test the security of your application?
Do you complete a security self-assessment against the latest MVSP release at least annually and make it available to customers?
Does an independent security vendor penetration test your product at least annually?
Do you provide role-specific security training to your personnel, relevant to their business function?
Do you hold an independent audit report, such as SOC 2, showing that you comply with an industry security standard?
Do you notify affected parties no later than 72 hours after discovering a breach of sensitive information?
Do you sanitize storage media that held production data, following NIST SP 800-88 or an equivalent, before reuse or disposal?
Can your customers sign in to your product through single sign-on with their own identity provider, at no additional cost?
Is your application served only over HTTPS?
Do you apply security headers, such as a Content Security Policy and framing controls, to limit your application's attack surface?
For accounts that sign in with a password, do you enforce a password policy such as a minimum length?
Do you build on maintained frameworks or libraries whose built-in protections handle input validation and output encoding?
Do you patch critical vulnerabilities in your application's third-party dependencies within a defined time frame?
Do you keep logs of security-relevant events, such as authentication, and collect them in a central logging system?
Do you use modern, industry-standard encryption to protect sensitive data at rest and in transit?
Do you classify the sensitive data your application processes into defined sensitivity levels?
Do you maintain an up-to-date diagram showing how sensitive data reaches your systems and where it ends up stored?
Do you train your developers to prevent authorization bypass, insecure session management, injection, cross-site scripting and cross-site request forgery?
Do you deploy fixes for critical vulnerabilities within 90 days of discovery?
Do production builds and deployments run only through an automated CI/CD pipeline?
Do your facilities have layered physical access controls, entry and exit logs, and a response plan for unauthorized access?
Do you limit access to sensitive data to people with a legitimate need?
Do you keep a list of third-party companies with access to customer data and make it available to customers?
Do you test your disaster recovery plan at least annually?
